Tantalizing Mediterranean Chicken Wrap
By: Kristi Rimkus
Published: Thursday, April 29, 2010 - 6:54am

Ingredients




1 tablespoon olive oil
1 medium bell pepper, red, yellow, or orange thinly sliced
1/2 small onion, thinly sliced
1/4 cup white wine
1/4 cup low fat chicken broth
1 clove garlic, minced
1 1/2 teaspoons oregano
1/2 medium lemon, juiced
2 cups baby spinach
2 cups chicken breast, cooked, and chopped
1/2 cup fat free feta cheese, crumbled
2 tablespoons parsley, minced
4 large whole wheat flour tortillas

Preparation

1 Heat non-stick skillet over medium heat with olive oil. Add bell pepper and cook for 3 – 4 minutes to soften. Add onion and cook another 5 minutes to soften. Add wine, chicken broth, lemon juice, oregano and garlic. Cook 25 minutes until cooked down, and vegetables are very soft. 2 Add cooked chicken and spinach and cook until spinach just wilts. 3 Heat tortillas in the microwave for 30 seconds, and then fill with 1/4 chicken mixture, feta cheese and parsley.

About


If you like Mediterranean flavors, you'll enjoy this easy wrap filled with chicken, colorful bell peppers, mushrooms, spinach and feta. 
Delicious and healthy too!
